Select assay ChEMBL ID, target type, tax ID, canonical SMILES, molecule ChEMBL ID, standard type, and pChEMBL value for IC50 activities against human single-protein target CHEMBL2157854 (Ubiquitin carboxyl-terminal hydrolase 8). Filter to exact standard relation '=' rows with non-null pChEMBL values. Require canonical SMILES via an INNER JOIN to compound_structures. Return all qualifying activity rows without deduplication. Sort by molecule ChEMBL ID and assay ChEMBL ID. Limit to the first 1000 rows.
